name: North Elko Pipeline

values.StartLocation: Ruby Pipeline main line valve near Willow Creek Reservoir

researcher_notes: Not an existing row. The roster has no Prospector, North Elko or Goldstrike line. The nearest rows are the Ruby Gas Pipeline (P0248) and the Great Basin line (P7856), and this is a separate spur off Ruby. An Engineering News-Record best-project article says 130,894 feet (nearly 25 miles, about 24.8 miles) of 12 inch coated steel pipe was laid from a Ruby Pipeline valve near Willow Creek Reservoir to the Barrick Goldstrike Mine, owned by Prospector Pipeline Co of Rancho Cordova, California, finished in under two months. The Energy Information Administration August 2026 project workbook (Historical Projects sheet, row 762) lists the North Elko Pipeline Project, Prospector Pipeline, lateral, completed December 2013, 24 miles, 12 inch, intrastate, state regulated. The two sources are independent. Length clears the 25 km rule (about 40 km). No gazetteer hit for the owner, so the name is kept as the article spells it. Start year 2013 is from the EIA completion date, the article is undated. The pipe is intrastate, so no FERC filing is expected. No route was researched, RouteType should be left for the routes step. Capacity and cost were not found.
